d: Long, wavy caramel-brown hair is tied in a side ponytail with thick bangs and two long strands framing the face, paired with wide, amber-colored eyes and an innocent expression. The face appears youthful and mature, with a slender and curvaceous build. The outfit consists of a white sleeveless top with a red-and-green necktie, long white detached sleeves with red trim, a grey armored corset with gold accents and chains, and a pleated red mini-skirt with green horizontal stripes. Signature accessories include a white nautical cap with a grey brim and grey mechanical rigging pieces attached at the waist.
